description: 中间象入场，驱后后吃挂马
explanation_en: White develops the bishop with tempo, attacking Black's queen. Once the queen moves away, White captures the loose knight on f6.

intro.popup: 💡 中间招：黑马f6无根是挂子。白方先Bc3！中间象入场攻击Qb6——后被驱走，Bxf6吃挂马！
intro.popup_en: 💡 Intermezzo: Black's knight on f6 is loose. White first plays Bc3, developing with an attack on the queen on b6; once it moves, Bxf6 wins the knight.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Bc3中间入场！黑后被迫离开b6，Bxf6吃掉挂马——局面顿时大优！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Bc3 is the intermediate move, attacking Black's queen and forcing it away from b6. White then captures the loose knight with Bxf6.

moves.popup: 白象Bc3！中间入场攻击Qb6——黑后无根，是挂子，必须逃！
moves.popup_en: White develops the bishop to c3 with tempo, attacking the loose queen on b6 and forcing it to move.
The queen retreats to b6, but the knight on f6 is still undefended.

moves.popup: 白象Bxf6！吃掉无根的挂马——中间招完成，白方得子大优！
moves.popup_en: White's bishop captures the loose knight on f6. The intermezzo wins material and gives White a large advantage.
